pages.text: ChemLib Nitric Acid develops $(l:components/pcb)PCB's/$ in an $(l:manufacturing/etching_tank)Etching Tank/$. Make it from saltpeter and sulfuric acid in an airtight Thermopneumatic Processing Plant.$(p)The former PneumaticCraft Etching Acid is not used.
Fill the Etching Tank with Nitric Acid, then add an Empty PCB. The tank consumes acid as the board develops.
